description: Does enrichment of reactive astrocytes within the CA1 pyramidal field capture memory decline signal beyond age, Braak, CERAD, and sex?
Is the memory-decline signal in CA1 astrocytic reactivity strongest specifically in astrocytes immediately adjacent to CA1 pyramidal neurons rather than across CA1 as a whole?
Does the proportion of CA1 pyramidal neurons that are locally cuffed by reactive astrocytes capture memory-decline signal beyond the existing astrocyte-centric reactivity fractions?

Does severe reactive-astrocyte cuffing of CA1 pyramidal neurons, defined by multiple nearby reactive astrocytes rather than any single neighbor, better capture memory-decline signal than the current broader CA1 reactivity features?

Does the fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons embedded in predominantly reactive local astrocyte cuffs capture memory-decline signal beyond the current broad reactivity and reactive-count cuffing features?
Does hypertrophy of reactive astrocytes in the immediate CA1 pyramidal niche capture memory-decline signal beyond the current count-based reactive cuffing features?

Does the average total reactive astrocyte area surrounding CA1 pyramidal neurons capture perineuronal glial-burden signal for memory decline better than the current separate cuff-count and single-cell hypertrophy summaries?

Does the fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons surrounded by a severe reactive-astrocyte cuff that also contains nearby lymphocytes capture an inflammatory perineuronal niche with memory-decline signal beyond the current astrocyte-only panel?

Among CA1 pyramidal neurons that already have a severe reactive-astrocyte cuff, does the fraction that are also lymphocyte-admixed capture a cleaner inflammatory niche signal for memory decline than the current mixed prevalence features?

Among CA1 pyramidal neurons that already have a severe reactive astrocyte cuff, does requiring multiple nearby lymphocytes identify a denser inflammatory perineuronal niche that predicts memory decline better than the current any-lymphocyte definition?
